claims: Gross income is total income from all sources before taxes and deductions.
Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) is gross income minus specific deductions like student loan interest or IRA contributions.
Net income is income remaining after taxes and expenses are deducted.
Net income is commonly referred to as "take-home pay".
Income is generally subject to federal, state, and local taxes.
Earned income is subject to income tax.
Earned income is subject to payroll taxes.
Payroll taxes include Social Security and Medicare.
Unearned income is taxed as part of overall income.
Unearned income is sometimes taxed at different rates.
Long-term capital gains are taxed at different rates.
Educator expenses can lower the taxable amount.
Student loan interest can lower the taxable amount.
Child support is generally not considered income.
Veterans' disability payments are generally not considered income.
Worker's compensation is generally not considered income.
